question: Who among the following is a Padma Shri Awardee for her contribution to Manipuri Dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Darshana Jhaveri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Darshana Jhaveri** is a renowned exponent of Manipuri dance, an Indian classical dance form.
 
• She has been honored with the **Padma Shri** award for her significant contribution to the field of Manipuri dance.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Darshana Jhaveri is part of the Jhaveri Sisters, a group celebrated for their dedication to and promotion of Manipuri dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** are one of the highest civilian honors in India and are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (for distinguished service of a high order), and **Padma Shri** (for distinguished service).
 
• Manipuri dance is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, known for its themes based on Vaishnavism and its graceful, fluid movements.
 
• Darshana Jhaveri and her sisters have been instrumental in popularizing Manipuri dance both in India and internationally.
